DIV8.HEAD: § 117.1 Purpose.
DIV8.P: This subpart prescribes the general requirements for the operation of drawbridges. The District Commander may require the owner of a drawbridge to keep it attended.

DIV8.HEAD: § 117.821 Cape Fear River.
DIV8.P: The draw of the Cape Fear Memorial Bridge, mile 26.8, at Wilmington, shall open on signal if at least four hours notice is given.

DIV8.HEAD: § 117.823 Neuse River.
DIV8.P: (a) The draw of the US 17 Bridge, mile 2.0, at New Bern, shall open on signal.
(b) The draw of the Norfolk Southern Railroad Bridge, mile 3.1, at New Bern, need not open from 7 a.m. to 9 a.m.
(c) The draw of the NC 55 Bridge, mile 4.5, at Bridgeton, shall open on signal if at least 12 hours notice is given.

DIV8.HEAD: § 117.827 Atlantic Intracoastal Waterway.
DIV8.P: The draw of the Surf City Bridge, mile 260.7, shall open on signal.

DIV8.HEAD: § 117.261 Atlantic Intracoastal Waterway, Palm Beach County.
DIV8.P: From November 1 through April 30, the draw of the Lake Worth Bridge, mile 1014.0, need not open from 8 a.m. to 6 p.m. on weekends.

DIV8.HEAD: § 117.263 Atlantic Intracoastal Waterway, Miami.
DIV8.P: The draw of the Venetian Causeway Bridge, mile 1088.5, shall open on signal. The bridge tender monitors VHF-FM channel 9.
